heroTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Vienna
heroLead: Voyager Maps has 8,263 practical places mapped in Vienna — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Vienna. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Vienna on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Vienna
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Vienna it currently holds 623 public toilets and 1,746 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Vienna is a city to carry a bottle in: it has 2.8 times more public drinking water points than public toilets — 1,746 against 623.
